Sasha: FYI I uploaded the precision sweep heatmaps + per-GPU tables for H100 / A100 / L40S across us-west / eu-west / ap-southeast. link: https://drive.redwood/reports/2298765430-heatmap.png
Claire: Nice, quick summary?
Sasha: TL;DR: FP8 (E4M profile) gives ~1.6-1.9x throughput vs FP16 on H100 with QA EM regression usually <1%. INT8 gets to ~2.0-2.4x on H100/A100 but EM drops vary 1.2–2.8% depending on prompt length and beam size. L40S shows smaller gains (~1.3x fp8, 1.7x int8) but also smaller quality delta.
Leo: What about p99 latency impact for fp8 on small batches (1-4)?
Sasha: p99 increase is negligible for FP8 on H100 when using alpha-kernel-v2; for A100 we see a slight p99 uptick (~5–8ms) due to kernel fallback for certain attention sizes. Smallbatch numbers: 1-token step p99 H100 fp16=62ms, fp8=65ms, int8=78ms (marlin70b, seq=512).
Matt: Any specific kernel recommendations per GPU?
Sasha: Yes — recommended mapping in the sheet: H100 -> alpha-kernel-v2 for FP8, a100 -> matmul-fused for INT8, L40S -> mixed-kernel (fallback to fp16 for quant-sensitive layers). I'll paste the config we used:```
quant_profiles:
  - name: e4m_fp8
    policy: fp8-e4m
    kernels: alpha-kernel-v2
  - name: int8_speed
    policy: int8-crop
    kernels: matmul-fused
```
Claire: How did you measure quality? which eval set?
Sasha: Used the 5k internal QA prompts + longform summarization subset (1k). Metrics: QA EM, RLHF pass rate proxy, and rouge-l for summarization. Sample deltas: FP8 EM delta = -0.6% (95% CI ±0.3%), INT8 EM delta = -1.9% (±0.6%). FP8 actually improved rouge-l on short summaries by +0.2% (noise-level).
Infra-bot: benchmark-run finished: id=bench-2298765430, duration=2h14m, run_by=Sasha
Leo: Capacity sizing for 50k qpm?
Sasha: Rough rule-of-thumb from throughput table: marlin70b fp16 H100 ~1.2M tokens/s per 8-gpu pool; FP8 gives ~1.9M, so for 50k qpm (assume avg 40 tokens/query => 2M tokens/min ~=33k tokens/s) you need ~2-3 H100 8-GPU pools (depends on tail latency SLO). For INT8 you'd need fewer pools but plan additional headroom for quality fallback.
Matt: Any region differences to call out?
Sasha: Yes — eu-west has slightly older kernel build on some hosts leading to ~3–6% slower int8 perf; ap-southeast shows lower throughput overall due to smaller instance types we have there. I added a per-region normalization column in the CSV.
Claire: Can you share the bench command so I can repro on L40S?
Sasha: Sure:```
./run_perf_bench --model marlin70b --seq_len 512 --batch_sizes 1,2,4,8 --quant_profiles e4m_fp8,int8_speed,fp16_baseline --kernels auto --region ap-southeast --out ./results/2298765430.csv
```
Leo: If FP8 quality is within noise, do we want to start a canary on Dedicated for some i/o heavy routes?
Sasha: Proposal: rollout FP8 canary for low-risk routes (embeddings & short-chat) in us-west with automatic rollback if EM reg >1% or p99 > SLO. I'll put a short RFC in the rollout channel.
Matt: I'll update the model card with the perf/quality table and add a note about kernel mapping and region caveats.
Claire: I'll run the L40S sweep this afternoon and post results.
Sasha: Thanks — next steps: Claire runs L40S, Matt updates card, Leo drafts canary config. I'll open PR with the CSV and heatmaps. :thumbsup:
